ex.create: Create - answer 201 with the new record

docs.idHint: always there, like created_at / updated_at - assigned when creating
docs.lists: Lists: page, limit (max. 200), s, sort (- = descending), filter[field] with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in, null, fields, include. References also allow fields of the referenced record: filter[country][name]=Germany, filter[country][region][name][like]=eu (up to 3 levels) and sort=country (by its display field) or sort=country[name]. Trees: slugs come as the whole path (world/europe/western-europe), filter[slug]=world/europe finds a record by its path. Fields of entities the client may not read cannot be used. Overview of all readable entities with their fields: {overview}. Project variables like {placeholder} are filled into the texts, all values are at {variables}.
docs.mediaDelete: Only files no record uses can be deleted (otherwise 409 media_in_use).
docs.mediaField: entity + field (optional): checks the allowed file types of the media field at once.
docs.mediaText: Files of the project can be uploaded and deleted if the API client may "upload media" or "delete media". The answer contains the id that goes into media fields, and the public url.
docs.mediaUnused: Unused files are removed after a day - unless uploaded with keep=1, then they stay in the media library.
docs.oauthText: entities need a token (OAuth 2.0 client credentials). Administrators add API clients under "API clients".
docs.publicText: entities can be read without signing in.
docs.sdk: There is a ready-made client for PHP: the {link} ({install}).
docs.status401: without or with an invalid token
docs.status403: the client may not do this
docs.subtitle: Read, create, edit and delete for websites and apps (headless). Answers are JSON.
docs.title: Content API
docs.writingChecks: The same checks as in the app apply: required fields, types, uniqueness, patterns, references and allowed file types. Values are read like in the import (12.50, 2025-10-29).
docs.writingDelete: Deleting moves into the trash if the entity has one. Records other records reference cannot be deleted (409).
docs.writingGenerated: Slugs, UUIDs and counters are filled in automatically when they are missing. Taken slugs get a number (home-2) - in trees only within the same level.
docs.writingMedia: Media fields take the id of a file - upload it first with POST /media (see below).
docs.writingPartial: When editing, only the sent fields change. null empties a field.
docs.writingText: Records can be created (POST), edited (PATCH/PUT) and deleted (DELETE) through the API. This always needs a token - public entities included - and an API client that may "Create", "Edit" or "Delete" in the entity (Administration › API clients).
docs.writingTranslations: Translatable fields: with ?lang=de the body is the German version, without the parameter the default language. Or {i18n}.

errors.unknown: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.

events.conditionHelp: Filter as in the content API, plus _changed (changed fields) and _old (state before). Empty = always.

editor.dataHelp: Field and value, placeholders welcome. JSON like ["a", "b"] is taken as list.
editor.digest: One digest for all records of the run
editor.envHelp: Enter the value or a .env variable with {'$'} – it is resolved only when sending.
editor.invalidJson: No valid JSON – the form shows the last valid state.
editor.noSteps: No steps yet – add one above.
editor.notAList: The steps must be a JSON list of objects.
editor.secretHelp: Signs the body (X-Excellent-Signature). A value or a {'$'} variable of the .env.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.urlHelp: Placeholders like {'{{'}record.id{'}}'} and .env variables as {'$'}NAME – suggested when typing {'$'}, {'$$'} for a {'$'}.
editor.webhookDigest: One call for all records of the run (otherwise one per record)
editor.whereHelp: Filter: field = value, e.g. ID = {'{{'}record.product{'}}'}. Comparisons as JSON, e.g. {'{'}"gte": 10{'}'}.
editor.continueOnErrorHelp: If this step fails, the next steps run anyway (the run counts as failed; "Retry" repeats only what failed).

modeHelp.queue: Runs in the worker (./yii queue:run events, e.g. by cron every minute).

events.stepsHelp: Several steps run one after the other; the first error stops the run.
events.subtitle: React to changes of records: check a condition, then call webhooks, send e-mails or create, change, delete records.

events.author: Only for entries by

fields.blockCategoriesHelp: Besides the ones chosen one by one - also blocks that come into these categories later.
fields.blockFirst: Add a block under Administration › Blocks first.
fields.blockTypesHelp: The blocks editors may line up here. This order is the order of the menu.
fields.convertValues: The existing value will be converted into the new type. If it does not fit, nothing changes. | The {n} existing values will be converted into the new type. If one does not fit, nothing changes.
fields.counterHelp: New records get the next number automatically, existing ones are numbered in the order they were created. The field is always unique; an entity has only one counter.
fields.counterTitle: The database counts up by itself (AUTO_INCREMENT).
fields.everyone: Everyone with permissions for the entity
fields.filterableHelp: filter[field] in the API and admin app – off: not searched either.
fields.groupFirst: Add a field group under Administration › Field groups first.
fields.groupHelp: The fields of the group come into the entity as an object - changes to the group apply everywhere.
fields.groupModeBlocksHelp: Page builder: editors line up blocks.
fields.groupModeGroupHelp: Always the same fields, e.g. SEO.
fields.matchHelp: Field of the target entity that contains the current values (e.g. ISO code)
fields.mediaAcceptHelp: Empty = all allowed types. "image/*" allows all images, "image/png" only PNG. Files are kept in the storage of the project.
fields.oneLanguage: The project has only one language - languages under Administration › Projects
fields.optionsHelp: The value is stored and returned by the API; the label is what the CMS shows.
fields.patternHelp: Without delimiters, e.g. {pattern} for "{example}". ^ and $ check the whole value.
fields.readRolesHelp: Only these roles (and admins) see the field – in the content API too. Without a token it is not public then.
fields.searchType: Search a type, e.g. png or video …
fields.searchWeightHelp: Matches in heavier fields come first – e.g. title 3×, text 1×. Takes effect at once, no rebuild needed.
fields.slugSourceHelp: An empty slug is made from this field ("About us" → about-us). Taken slugs get a number (home-2).
fields.title: Fields
fields.translationsLost: The translations of this field will be deleted - only the default language stays.
fields.uuidHelp: Empty values of new records are generated automatically - existing records get a UUID at once.
fields.writeRolesHelp: Only these roles (and admins) may change it.
fields.sliderHelp: Edited with a slider from minimum to maximum (needs both).

roles.takeOverHelp: May take over records others are editing.

schema.convertHelp: The chosen fields become one group field - with all existing values and translations. The group can be reused in other entities afterwards. Groups have no unique fields.
schema.convertTitle: Turn fields into a field group
schema.deleteField: Delete the field "{field}" with all values?
schema.deleteHelp: Deletes the table with all {count} records. Only possible while no other entity references it.
schema.deleteQuestion: Delete "{entity}" with all records for good?
schema.draftsHelp: Records can be saved as drafts: visible in the CMS, not available through the content API. Required fields are checked when publishing.
schema.globalHelp: Shared with all projects - they can be referenced from here, their schema is kept in the area "Global".
schema.globalSubtitle: Global entities: all projects see them, can reference them and serve them through their content API.
schema.groupFieldName: Name of the group field in this entity
schema.groupFieldNameHelp: The name of the object in the API, e.g. seo.
schema.groupHelp: It needs fields of the same names and types.
schema.labelFieldHelp: Shown when other records reference this one.
schema.listSubtitle: Entities and their fields. New entities usually come from an import.
schema.noGlobal: No global entities yet - e.g. countries can be moved to Global with "Copy to project".
schema.previewUrlHelp: Page of the website that shows a record as preview. Placeholders: {'{{'}id{'}}'}, {'{{'}entity{'}}'}, {'{{'}lang{'}}'}, {'{{'}record.slug{'}}'} … and {'{{'}token{'}}'} (required) – with ?preview=<token> the content API delivers drafts and working copies. {'$'}NAME for .env variables.
schema.revisionsHelp: Every change of a record is kept as revision: history, compare and restore. Switching it off keeps the revisions there are.
schema.slugWarning: Careful: API consumers must use the new address.
schema.subtitle: {count} record · table {table} | {count} records · table {table}
schema.trashHelp: Deleted records go to the trash first and can be restored. It can only be switched off while the trash is empty.
schema.treeHelp: Records are shown as a tree in the list (e.g. pages with subpages).
schema.treeHint: Add a field "Reference to an entity" that references "{entity}" itself (e.g. parent).
schema.uniqueTogetherHelp: These fields may occur together only once (e.g. first name + last name + date of birth).

search.hint: Search all entities of this project.

searchIndex.staleText: Until it is rebuilt, ?s= searches the columns – without stop words and relevance.
searchIndex.staleTitle: {n} index is stale | {n} indexes are stale
searchIndex.stopwordsExample: the and or of a an
searchIndex.stopwordsHelp: Words that are not indexed and ignored in searches – separated by spaces.

storages.private: Private: the CMS serves the files

storages.publicHelp: The storage serves the files itself at its public URL. Fast, but not protected.

users.projectsHelp: The user only sees these projects. The permissions per entity apply in the respective project.

roleHelp.admin: Can do everything: schema, users, API clients.
roleHelp.editor: Like an author, and can take over records others are editing.
roleHelp.author: Works with the permissions below.

users.rolesHelp: The permissions of the roles count in addition to its own below.

users.writeImpliesRead: Edit, create, delete and import include read.
